uḍḍayhana: [U+daha+yu] (na) CL=7 A period of burning. See - Uḍḍayhanavelā.
uḍḍepana: [U+ḍī+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 Make it fly up. See - Uḍḍepanākāra.
uḍḍepanākāra: [Uḍḍepana+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of making it fly up.
uḍḍeti: [U+ḍī+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He flies. (2) He sets (a snare, net, trap).
uḍḍitvā: [U+ḍī+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused it to fly up. Having caused it to ascend.
uḍḍāpenta: [U+ḍī+ṇāpe+anta] (ti) CL=7 Causes to fly up. Causes to run.
uḍḍāpetvā: [U+ḍī+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused it to fly up. Having caused it to ascend.
